meta.project: CRM External Sales - Sistema de Gestión de Ventas Externas

product_overview: Backend APIs to manage authentication, users, tours, transfers, suppliers, reservations, reports and file uploads for a CRM focused on external sales for a tourism company. Exposes role-based endpoints (admin/agent/customer) with validations, pagination and integrations (Supabase Auth & Storage, Prisma/Postgres).
core_goals: Provide secure role-based REST APIs for managing users, tours, transfers, suppliers and reservations.
Automate reservation pricing calculations (tour, transfer, subtotal, IVA, discounts, total).
Support media uploads for tours via Supabase Storage and manage tour schedules and images.
Expose report generation endpoints with aggregations and filters for administrative analytics.
Enforce input validation, pagination and rate limiting to ensure reliability and maintainability.

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Authenticate users, manage sessions and handle password recovery via Supabase Auth.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with user and session token -> GET /api/user with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile -> POST /api/auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 success
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with registered email -> Receive 200 success (reset email sent) -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token and new_password -> Receive 200 success
POST /api/auth/reset-password with invalid or expired token and new_password -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: User Management API
features.description: Admin CRUD for application users and endpoints for current user profile management.
user_flows: POST /api/users with admin token and body {username,email,password,role,phone} -> Receive 200 Created user -> GET /api/users?page=1&limit=10 with admin token -> Receive 200 user list with pagination
GET /api/users/[username] with valid token -> Receive 200 user object
PUT /api/users/[username] with admin token and body {email,phone,role} -> Receive 200 Updated user
DELETE /api/users/[username] with admin token -> Receive 200 Success message
POST /api/users with agent token and body {username,email,password,role,phone} -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
GET /api/users/[nonexistent_username] with admin token -> Receive 404 User not found
GET /api/user with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 current user profile -> PUT /api/user with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {phone,email} -> Receive 200 Updated profile
PUT /api/user with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid email format -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Tours Management API
features.description: Create, list, update and delete tours; manage tour images and schedules (admin-only where indicated).
user_flows: POST /api/tours with admin token multipart/form-data (tour JSON + images[]) -> Receive 200 Created tour with ID -> GET /api/tours?page=1&limit=10&type=EcoTour&availability=available with token -> Receive 200 Tour list with pagination
GET /api/tours/:id with token -> Receive 200 Tour object including images and schedules
POST /api/tours/:id/images with admin token and body {path,alt,is_cover,sort_order} -> Receive 200 Created image -> GET /api/tours/:id/images with token -> Receive 200 Image list
POST /api/tours/:id/schedules with admin token and body [{weekday,start_time}] -> Receive 200 Created schedule(s) -> GET /api/tours/:id/schedules with token -> Receive 200 Schedule list
PUT /api/tours/:id with admin token and body {name,description,type,availability,base_price,spots} -> Receive 200 Updated tour
DELETE /api/tours/:id with admin token -> Receive 200 Success message (or 404 Tour not found)
POST /api/tours with agent token and multipart/form-data -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
POST /api/tours/:id/images with admin token and missing required fields -> Receive 400 Validation error
PUT /api/tours/:nonexistent_id with admin token -> Receive 404 Tour not found

features.name: Transfers Management API
features.description: Manage vehicle transfers with supplier association: list, create, update and delete (admin-only for write ops).
user_flows: POST /api/transfers with admin token and body {license_plate,availability,make,model,category,capacity,type,base_price,sale_price,supplier_corporate} -> Receive 200 Created transfer -> GET /api/transfers?page=1&limit=10&make=Toyota with token -> Receive 200 Transfer list with pagination
GET /api/transfers with token and filters {category,availability} -> Receive 200 Filtered list
PUT /api/transfers/:id with admin token and body {availability,make,model,category,capacity,base_price,sale_price} -> Receive 200 Updated transfer
DELETE /api/transfers/:id with admin token -> Receive 200 Success message
POST /api/transfers with agent token -> Receive 403 Forbidden
PUT /api/transfers/:nonexistent_id with admin token -> Receive 404 Transfer not found

features.name: Suppliers Management API
features.description: CRUD operations for suppliers (corporate ID primary key). Admin-only for create/update/delete; admin and agent can list and view.
user_flows: POST /api/suppliers with admin token and body {corporate,company,phone,email,service} -> Receive 200 Created supplier -> GET /api/suppliers?page=1&limit=10&company=Acme with admin/agent token -> Receive 200 Supplier list with pagination
GET /api/suppliers/:corporate with admin/agent token -> Receive 200 Supplier object
PUT /api/suppliers/:corporate with admin token and body {company,phone,email,service} -> Receive 200 Updated supplier
DELETE /api/suppliers/:corporate with admin token -> Receive 200 Success message
POST /api/suppliers with duplicate corporate value and admin token -> Receive 400/409 Duplicate resource error
DELETE /api/suppliers/:corporate where supplier has associated tours/transfers with admin token -> Receive 400 Cannot delete supplier with associated tours/transfers
GET /api/suppliers with customer token -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
PUT /api/suppliers/:nonexistent_corporate with admin token -> Receive 404 Supplier not found

features.name: Reservations Management API
features.description: Create, list, update and cancel reservations with automatic price calculations and role-based visibility (agents create, admins update/cancel).
user_flows: POST /api/reservations with agent token and body {tour_id,people,date,time,hotel_reservation,note,transfer_id?} -> Receive 200 Created reservation with calculated fields {reservation_id,tour_amount,transfer_amount,subtotal,iva,discount,total}
POST /api/reservations with agent token and valid tour_id and transfer_id -> Receive 200 Created with both tour_amount and transfer_amount included
GET /api/reservations with admin token -> Receive 200 Reservation list (admin sees all) -> GET /api/reservations with agent token -> Receive 200 Reservation list (agent sees own only)
PUT /api/reservations/:id with admin token and body {people} -> Receive 200 Updated reservation with recalculated amounts
PUT /api/reservations/:id with admin token and body {state:"cancelled",cancellation_reason:"Client request"} -> Receive 200 Cancelled reservation
POST /api/reservations with missing required field tour_id and agent token -> Receive 400 Validation error
POST /api/reservations with customer token -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
PUT /api/reservations/:nonexistent_id with admin token -> Receive 404 Reservation not found
POST /api/reservations with invalid date or time formats -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Reports API
features.description: Generate administrative reports with KPIs, chart data and reservation lists, filtered by period and other dimensions (admin-only).
user_flows: GET /api/reports?tipo_reporte=trimestral&fecha_inicio=2025-01-01&fecha_fin=2025-03-31&granularidad_temporal=mes with admin token -> Receive 200 Report containing {kpis,grafico,reservas}
GET /api/reports?tipo_reporte=personalizado&fecha_inicio=2025-01-01&fecha_fin=2025-12-31&tourId=123&estado=confirmed with admin token -> Receive 200 Filtered report
GET /api/reports without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/reports with agent token -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
GET /api/reports with missing tipo_reporte or missing granularidad_temporal for time-based reports -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /api/reports with invalid date format (fecha_inicio=2025-13-01) with admin token -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /api/reports for date range where fecha_fin < fecha_inicio with admin token -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: File Upload API
features.description: Upload image files to Supabase Storage for use by tours and other entities (admin-only).
user_flows: POST /api/upload with admin token multipart/form-data file=image.jpg -> Receive 200 Uploaded file path
POST /api/upload with missing file in multipart/form-data and admin token -> Receive 400 Validation error
POST /api/upload with agent token and file=image.jpg -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
POST /api/upload with admin token when Supabase Storage is not configured -> Receive 500 Storage configuration error

features.name: Development Tools API
features.description: Development-only utilities to inspect and reset rate limiting (no auth required in dev).
user_flows: GET /api/dev/reset-rate-limit -> Receive 200 Rate limit statistics
POST /api/dev/reset-rate-limit -> Receive 200 Success message (rate limits cleared)
POST /api/dev/reset-rate-limit with malformed body -> Receive 400 Validation or ignored body with 200 success depending on dev implementation
